entities.name: Battle of Mohács & Tripartite Partition
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The disastrous Battle of Mohács (August 29, 1526), where King Louis II was killed, led to Ottoman conquest of Buda (1541) and Hungary's division into three parts: Ottoman Hungary, Royal (Habsburg) Hungary, and the Principality of Transylvania.
